tagline: The smallest and closest of the inhabited Princes' Islands — a quick escape with a village feel, beautiful walks, and far fewer visitors than Büyükada.

items.name: İskele Çay Bahçesi
items.description: The small café at the landing with island views. Very simple, very pleasant. The right pace for Kınalıada.

items.name: Ada Restoranları
items.description: A handful of small restaurants in the village serving simple fish and grills. Unpretentious and inexpensive.

items.name: Çam Tepe (Pine Hill) Walk
items.description: A walk to the island's pine-forested hilltop with good Marmara views. Short but satisfying.
items.tip: The walk takes about 30 minutes. Go early in the day before the ferry crowds arrive.

tips: Kınalıada is the first Princes' Island stop from Kabataş or Bostancı — about 25-30 minutes.
Much quieter and less visited than Büyükada. Good for a half-day trip.
The island is small enough to walk around in 90 minutes. No bicycles needed.
No cars allowed — a truly peaceful escape from the city.
